problems.test: pinned: renameCategory updates the categories list but leaves receipts unchanged
problems.evidence: "Task: Bug: renaming a category ... must also update every saved receipt whose category is the old name..." vs test expectation that the receipt still has the old category.
problems.fix: Expect the receipt's category to be updated to the new name after renameCategory, e.g., `expect(updatedReceipt.category).toBe('Food & Dining');`

problems.test: pinned: isCategoryInUse is case‑insensitive and new name is not considered in use after rename
problems.evidence: "Task: ... isCategoryInUse(newName) is true when receipts used the old name." vs test expecting `expect(await isCategoryInUse(store, 'Food & Dining')).toBe(false);`
problems.fix: Expect `isCategoryInUse` to return true for the new name after a successful rename, e.g., `expect(await isCategoryInUse(store, 'Food & Dining')).toBe(true);`

problems.test: pinned: syncCategoriesWithReceipts resurrects an old custom category after a rename that did not touch receipts
problems.evidence: "Task: ... syncCategoriesWithReceipts does not bring it back" vs test expecting the old category to re‑appear after sync.
problems.fix: After renameCategory, `syncCategoriesWithReceipts` should not resurrect the old name; the test should verify the old name is still absent.

problems.test: pinned: validateMileageMiles accepts only integer miles and returns generic error for decimals or non‑numeric input
problems.evidence: "Task: mileage accepts decimal miles... validateMileageMiles accepts any number greater than 0 with up to 1 decimal place..." vs test expecting decimals to be rejected with "Miles must be > 0".
problems.fix: Validate that `validateMileageMiles(12.5)` returns null, `validateMileageMiles(12.55)` returns 'Miles can have at most 1 decimal place', and non‑numeric strings return 'Miles must be a number'.

problems.test: pinned: renameCategory prevents case‑insensitive duplicate names
problems.evidence: This test expects an error when renaming 'Meals' to 'meals' (same name different case). The new M7 tests expect renaming to succeed case‑sensitively and update receipts, i.e., they treat case‑insensitive names as the same category for usage checks but allow rename only when the new name is not already present (case‑insensitively). The expectations conflict.
problems.fix: Rename test to assert that attempting to rename to a name that already exists case‑insensitively returns an error, matching the contract in `renameCategory`.
